title: Potential Extensions and Resources to Learn More

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: So we've gone over a bunch of improvements in PyTorch 2.0 and we've done a bunch of experiments to see what happens when we use torch compile and don't use it.
cues.zh: 我們介紹了 PyTorch 2.0 許多改善，也做了不少實驗，看看有無 torch.compile 時會發生什麼。

cues.en: And you might be wondering why I've already typed these out.
cues.zh: 你可能好奇，為什麼這些已經打好了。

cues.en: Well, it's because I previously recorded this video, but then I saved it and it errored.
cues.zh: 因為之前錄過這段影片，但儲存時出錯。

cues.en: So rather than retype it out, let's just discuss some possible improvements and extensions and resources to learn more.
cues.zh: 所以不重打，直接討論可能的改善、延伸與深入學習資源。

cues.en: And of course all of these are available in the PyTorch 2.0 tutorial ebook version.
cues.zh: 當然，PyTorch 2.0 教學的電子書版本都有。

cues.en: We're talking about Section five here, possible improvements in extensions.
cues.zh: 這裡談的是第五部分，可能的改善與延伸。

cues.en: And I've even got a beautiful little keynote.
cues.zh: 也有漂亮的 Keynote。

cues.en: One of the best ways to get improvements in deep learning is to use as much as the GPU as possible.
cues.zh: 改善深度學習速度的一個好方法，是盡可能充分利用 GPU。

cues.en: So that involves loading as much data as you can to the GPU through a bigger batch size or more powerful CPUs.
cues.zh: 也就是用更大的 batch_size，或更強的 CPU，把盡可能多的資料載入 GPU。

cues.en: Now in previous experience, Google CoLab defaulted to two CPUs, but as we've seen, if you upgrade to Google CoLab Pro or other tiers, you may get more than two CPUs.
cues.zh: 之前的經驗中，Colab 預設兩個 CPU；但現在看到，升級 Pro 或其他等級後，可能得到兩個以上。

cues.en: So this will improve your ability to load data to the GPU.
cues.zh: 這會提高把資料載入 GPU 的能力。

cues.en: Now of course this will be machine dependent.
cues.zh: 當然，取決於機器。

cues.en: It depends on how many CPUs you have, it depends on what type of CPUs they have.
cues.zh: 取決於有多少 CPU，也取決於 CPU 類型。

cues.en: But the principle remains the same.
cues.zh: 但原則相同。

cues.en: If you can get as much data on the GPU as possible, your training speeds should relatively increase.
cues.zh: 盡可能把資料放到 GPU，訓練速度應該相對提高。

cues.en: Another phenomenal technique we haven't quite gone through yet, but we've hinted at it is to use automatic mixed precision training, which is AMP.
cues.zh: 另一個很棒、還沒詳細介紹但暗示過的技術，是自動混合精度訓練，也就是 AMP。

cues.en: So automatic mixed precision.
cues.zh: 自動混合精度。

cues.en: And there's a note here in the PyTorch 2.0 tutorial documentation use mixed precision training.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2.0 教學文件裡有個註記，使用混合精度訓練。

cues.en: So PyTorch have a great documentation set up here.
cues.zh: PyTorch 的文件很棒。

cues.en: What this is going to do is it's going to mix between float 32 and float 16 for training.
cues.zh: 這會在訓練時，混合使用 float32 與 float16。

cues.en: So you can go through here, try that out.
cues.zh: 你可以閱讀並試試。

cues.en: And on GPUs, which are capable of using float 16 for training.
cues.zh: 在能使用 float16 訓練的 GPU 上，

cues.en: Yeah, there we go.
cues.zh: 對，這裡。

cues.en: Instances of torch cuda grad scale help perform the steps of gradient scaling conveniently.
cues.zh: torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler 實例，能方便地執行梯度縮放的步驟。

cues.en: Gradient scaling improves convergence for networks with float16 gradients.
cues.zh: 梯度縮放有助於使用 float16 梯度的網路收斂。

cues.en: So what I mean by this is it's going to go in between Float32, which is the default data type in PyTorch and Float16.
cues.zh: 意思是，會在 PyTorch 預設的 float32 與 float16 之間搭配使用。

cues.en: So oftentimes you can represent data with Float32, but you can make calculations with Float16 and that
cues.zh: 通常可以用 float32 表示資料，但以 float16 計算，

cues.en: is going to improve your calculation time or your processing time because you're using less numbers to represent a number during the calculation.
cues.zh: 因為計算時使用較少位元表示數字，能改善計算或處理時間。

cues.en: So that's another great way to improve.
cues.zh: 所以這是改善，

cues.en: Training.
cues.zh: 訓練的另一個好方法。

cues.en: This will probably actually be the biggest speedup that you'll see.
cues.zh: 實際上，這可能帶來你看到最大的加速，

cues.en: Mixed precision training, at least in my experience.
cues.zh: 至少依我經驗，混合精度訓練，

cues.en: That's what I've seen.
cues.zh: 是我見過，

cues.en: The biggest speed ups.
cues.zh: 加速最大的方法。

cues.en: Another one Number three is that transformer based models may seem more relative speed ups than convolutional.
cues.zh: 第三，Transformer 類模型的相對加速，可能比卷積模型更多。

cues.en: So convolutional neural networks have been out for quite a while now.
cues.zh: 卷積神經網路已經存在滿久。

cues.en: And so a lot of the hardware that you compute on such as NVIDIA GPUs have been optimized to perform convolutional operations.
cues.zh: 所以 NVIDIA GPU 等許多運算硬體，已經針對卷積操作做過最佳化。

cues.en: However, PyTorch 2.0, as said in the release notes.
cues.zh: 不過，PyTorch 2.0 的發布說明，

cues.en: I've got a link here has accelerated PyTorch to Transformers.
cues.zh: 這裡有連結，介紹了 PyTorch 2 對 Transformer 的加速。

cues.en: So the attention mechanism which we covered in.
cues.zh: 注意力機制，我們在，

cues.en: Paper replicating which powers the vision transformer.
cues.zh: 論文重現中介紹過，它是 Vision Transformer 的核心。

cues.en: The attention mechanism is what powers The transformer based model has a speed up for the scaled DOT
cues.zh: 注意力機制支撐 Transformer 模型，這裡加速的是 scaled dot-

cues.en: product attention, which is the main function in the attention mechanism computes scaled dot product attention on query key and value tensors using an optional attention mask if passed.
cues.zh: product attention，縮放點積注意力，也就是注意力的主要函式。它對 query、key、value 張量計算縮放點積注意力，如果傳入，也會使用可選的注意力遮罩。

cues.en: So this has been optimized to work on various different hardwares.
cues.zh: 這已經針對不同硬體最佳化。

cues.en: PyTorch 2.0 will behind the scenes choose which is the fastest kernel to use.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2.0 會在背後選擇最快的核心實作。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 這裡。

cues.en: Kernel to me is just operation.
cues.zh: 對我來說，kernel 就是操作，

cues.en: What operation it uses or what implementation of an operation.
cues.zh: 使用哪種操作，或者該操作的哪種實作。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Optimized kernels auto choose flash attention, memory efficient attention or a pytorch implementation defined in cplusplus matching the above formulation so it chooses one of those behind the scenes for
cues.zh: 最佳化核心會自動選擇 FlashAttention、記憶體效率注意力，或符合上方公式、以 C++ 定義的 PyTorch 實作，在背後替你

cues.en: you.
cues.zh: 選其中之一。

cues.en: So if you're using a transformer based model and it leverages the scaled dot product attention module behind the scenes, you should see a relative speed up from PyTorch 1.2 2.0.
cues.zh: 所以，如果使用的 Transformer 模型，底層運用縮放點積注意力模組，從 PyTorch 1 升到 2.0，應該能看到相對加速。

cues.en: Finally, one of the best ways to see more potential relative speedups is to train for longer.
cues.zh: 最後，另一個看到更多相對加速的好方法，是訓練更久。

cues.en: So in our experiments we trained for only five epochs, but we saw that if we run for three times five epochs, we get an improvement here.
cues.zh: 我們只訓練五個週期，但看到三次、每次五個週期，就有改善。

cues.en: And so you can imagine if you train for, say, 600 epochs like they did in the PyTorch computer vision state of the Art series, you will see a much bigger relative speed up across the longer training run
cues.zh: 所以想像，如果像 PyTorch 最先進電腦視覺系列那樣訓練 600 個週期，較長訓練的相對加速，會比我們這種短訓練

cues.en: than a shorter training one run than what we did here.
cues.zh: 更明顯。
